## FAQ

### Do I need to make an appointment?

Walk-ins are accepted when we have availability, but appointments are recommended to secure your preferred time slot and stylist. WhatsApp 9636 3537 is the fastest way to book. You can also call 6909 7503 during opening hours.

### What are your opening hours?

We are open daily from 9:30 am to 8:30 pm, including weekends and public holidays.

### Where are you located?

We are located at 50 East Coast Rd, #01-135, Roxy Square II, Singapore 428769. It is conveniently located near the Katong area.

### Do you offer services for children and men?

Yes, we offer haircuts and services for men, women, and children. We are a family-friendly salon.

### What payment methods do you accept?

We accept Cash, PayNow, NETS, and major Credit Cards.

### Will I know the price before service starts?

Yes. Our menu is published with clear prices, and we will confirm the expected price with you before any service begins. If your hair length, condition or service choice would change the price, we will tell you upfront — not after the service is done.

### What happens during a consultation?

Before colour, perm, treatment, lash or IPL services, we check your hair, scalp or skin condition, ask about your previous services and lifestyle, and discuss what you want the result to look like. We then explain the suitable options, the time required, and the price — so you can decide without pressure.

### What are your most popular services?

Customers most often book everyday haircuts, hair colour and highlights, perms (digital, cool perm, rebonding), keratin and scalp treatments, classic and gel manicures and pedicures, and eyelash extensions. WhatsApp us if you are not sure which service is suitable.

### Will you push me to add extra services?

No. We may suggest a treatment if it would clearly help your hair condition, but the decision is always yours. If you only want the service you booked, that is what you will get — at the price on the menu.
